title: NTP exporter - Probe
description: Health and accuracy of NTP servers monitored from a central place.

panels.title: Falsetickers
panels.description: Servers whose correctness interval misses the majority intersection.

panels.title: Consensus majority
panels.description: Whether more than half of the servers agree (RFC 5905 selection), and how many. Without majority, the consensus offset and the falsetickers are not computed.

panels.title: NTS key exchange failures
panels.description: NTS servers whose last key exchange failed.

panels.title: First NTS certificate expiry
panels.description: Time left before the first NTS key exchange certificate expires.

panels.title: /probe targets failing
panels.description: Targets scraped through /probe?target= without a valid measurement.

panels.title: Servers
panels.description: Last cycle per server. offset and rtt come from the sample with the lowest delay.

panels.title: Offset from consensus
panels.description: Offset of each server against the consensus of all servers: independent of the clock of the host running the probe.

panels.title: Jitter (RFC 5905)
panels.description: RMS of the offset differences between the lowest-delay sample and the others.

panels.title: Root distance
panels.description: Upper bound of the error of the server time (RFC 5905 synchronization distance).

panels.title: Reference age
panels.description: Time since the server clock was last set or corrected.

panels.title: Polling slowed down by RATE
panels.description: Multiplier of the polling interval of each server after RATE Kiss-o'-Death codes: 1 is the normal polling, it doubles at each RATE and goes back down while the server answers.

panels.title: NTS key exchange
panels.description: Result of the last NTS-KE (TLS, port 4460), expiry of its certificate and NTP server negotiated by the key exchange. The key exchange runs again every hour.

panels.title: Probe success
panels.description: ntp_probe_success of each /probe?target= scrape (instance is the target).

panels.title: Probe duration
panels.description: Duration of the burst; it must stay below the scrape timeout.
